tablet.notes:
Voicemail: new voicemails now appear and notify by themselves
Voicemail opens instantly from saved data and updates quietly
Listening marks it heard on the phone and at Verizon
Playback speed button (1x to 3x), and you can pick a spot before pressing play
Sync icon spins; Delete now offers Undo after the question
No back arrow on Calls and Voicemail with the Dock; What's New pop-up removed
